banners.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene.
Create ONE square 1024x1024 image-only navigation banner for Viet Ky, as part of one consistent illustrated series.

Image 1 is the APPROVED STYLE MASTER. Match its hand-ink line quality, moderate detail, weathered yet restrained materials, flat cel-shaded color planes, warm aged-paper texture and muted moss/earth/brick palette. This approved master is the detailed version, not pristine minimal vector art.
Image 2 is a SUBJECT/COMPOSITION reference only. Reinterpret its content in the exact rendering language of Image 1; do not keep photographic lighting or photographic depth of field. Do not borrow the archway, temple or mountains from Image 1 unless the requested subject explicitly includes them.

The same illustrator should appear to have made every image: dark brown contour lines of consistent weight; two or three flat shadow values; matte ivory #FFF9F1 paper, earth brown #B1957A, muted moss #6B7F5B, deep vermilion #8B1E1E, subdued ochre and charcoal. Restrained saturation and contrast; never cinematic orange-yellow grading. Slight irregular hand-drawn surfaces, faint consistent paper grain. Use weathering only where appropriate to the subject, not random speckles across every object. Maintain clear silhouettes and a single dominant subject at thumbnail size.

Composition: full-bleed square; main focus in the center/upper-middle; lower 20-25 percent stays relatively quiet for a separately rendered website caption. Keep the existing subject recognizable, with a simple supporting background.
Vietnamese cultural details must remain specifically Vietnamese. Keep props and architecture plausible; no fabricated motifs, unreadable pseudo-writing, Chinese/Japanese palace substitutions or costume mashups.

Strict exclusions: no text, letters, calligraphy, numbers, labels, logo, watermark, UI, decorative frame, circle medallion, collage, multiple panels, glossy 3D, soft airbrush, fake bokeh, lens effects, bloom, god rays, fantasy haze, excessive ornament, unnecessary extra objects or generic stock-vector perfection. Do not add a uniform arch motif to all images. No visual joke or mascot.
Requested subject: ONE handcrafted Vietnamese non la conical hat beside a draped piece of muted dark vermilion silk on a bamboo table. A quiet timber veranda and a few soft foliage silhouettes behind.
